Enterprise SaaS · Cybersecurity · Compliance

Phishing Simulation Platform

LRN Technologies · Sept 2023 – Nov 2025

RoleUX Consultant — Outsourced
PlatformEnterprise Web SaaS
IndustryCybersecurity · Compliance
Project Type0 → 1 Product Design
Discovery & Research

The Problem

LRN's compliance training suite lacked a native phishing simulation capability. Security teams managed campaigns manually across disconnected tools — with no unified analytics, no reusable template library, and no mechanism to close the loop between a failed simulation and remediation training.

!No centralised platform for launching, managing, and tracking phishing simulations
!Campaign configuration required multiple disconnected tools and manual CSV exports
!No reusable template system — every campaign built from scratch by security teams
!Reporting buried in raw data exports with no actionable risk scoring or trend view
!No direct connection between simulation failures and LRN's remediation training modules

Objective

Design a purpose-built phishing simulation platform integrating natively into LRN’s compliance ecosystem — enabling security teams to launch campaigns, monitor real-time engagement, identify at-risk employees, and automatically assign remediation training.

Design Goals

✓Campaign creation in under 5 minutes for security admins
✓Real-time risk scores surfaced at individual and team level
✓Reusable template library reducing campaign setup overhead
✓Closed-loop: failure → training assignment automated
✓WCAG 2.1 AA accessible, GDPR-compliant data handling
Discovery
Definition
Wireframes
Visual Design
Handoff & Iterate
Methodology

End-to-end engagement from discovery through post-launch iteration — working in cross-functional sprints with Product, Engineering, and the Security Advisory team across 6 defined design phases.

Design Impact

WCAG Compliance

Reduced Campaign Friction

The simplified campaign builder eliminated the manual overhead requiring coordination across multiple tools. Campaign setup time dropped significantly from the baseline.

Actionable Risk Visibility

By translating raw click data into individual and departmental risk scores on the dashboard, security teams gained an at-a-glance posture indicator rather than manually deriving signals from export files.

Closed-Loop Remediation

Automatic training assignment on simulation failure created a direct, measurable connection between awareness gap and remediation — the key missing link in LRN’s compliance ecosystem.

“Designing for enterprise security workflows meant balancing the urgency of real-world threat simulation with the administrative needs of teams managing compliance at scale — every interaction had to earn its place.”

Abhishek Patade — UX Consultant, LRN Technologies

Discovery & Research

The Challenge

Wine region travellers had no single platform to discover, compare, and book curated experiences across the South African Winelands. Existing tools were fragmented, expensive, and lacked a savings mechanism for repeat visitors.

!No single platform for discovering Winelands experiences
!Bookings scattered across multiple websites and phone calls
!No cost-saving mechanism for regular wine region visitors
!Poor mobile experience for on-the-go travel decisions
!No personalised pass or digital ticket management

Objective

Design a premium, easy-to-use platform that helps users discover and book curated wine experiences, stays, and tastings — while offering cost-saving passes that make repeat visits more affordable and rewarding.

Design Goals

✓Intuitive experience discovery across categories
✓Pass-based savings clearly communicated at every step
✓Smooth, low-friction booking and checkout flow
✓Personal pass management with QR redemption
✓Premium visual identity matching the brand

Enterprise SaaS · Insurtech · Internal Tool

Digital1st CST Tracker

Majesco · Concept Wireframe · Oct 2018 – Dec 2021

RoleLead Product Designer
PlatformEnterprise Web SaaS
IndustryInsurtech · Professional Services
Project TypeInternal Concept Tool
Discovery & Research

The Problem

Majesco’s Digital1st delivery teams were tracking customer project health, resource utilisation, and financial performance across spreadsheets and disconnected systems. With 9+ active client implementations running in parallel, there was no single source of truth for revenue vs cost, capacity availability, or cross-account resource allocation.

!No unified view of revenue, cost, and gross margin across all active customer implementations
!Resource allocation tracked in spreadsheets — no visibility into over-commitment or availability gaps
!No standardised billing rate structure linked to resource grades and factory costs
!Project phase and customer data siloed — delivery leads lacked real-time project status tracking
!No pipeline visibility — upcoming resource needs vs current capacity unknown until too late

Objective

Design a purpose-built internal tracking platform for Majesco’s Digital1st Professional Services team — consolidating customer project tracking, resource allocation management, financial performance monitoring, and billing configuration into a single, decision-ready enterprise tool.

Design Goals

✓Single overview dashboard for revenue, cost & GM across all DBUs
✓6-month rolling resource allocation view per team member
✓Customer-project-phase hierarchy with inline date management
✓Factory cost master for grade-based billing rate governance
✓Quarterly financial projections vs actuals with YTD tracking

IA & Flows
Concept Design
Review

What I Designed

Key Modules

Executive Overview Dashboard

Annual revenue target progress, gross margin %, monthly revenue vs cost vs GM% chart, and DBU resource utilisation — designed for director-level decision-making.

Factory Cost Master

Admin-controlled grade-to-hourly-rate table (T1 to G16+) that drives all gross margin calculations — editable by authorised roles only.

08
Projects Actual vs Budgeted

Per-project financial performance: budgeted vs actual revenue and cost — identifying at-risk projects before end-of-quarter review.

B2C E-commerce · 2-Wheeler Marketplace · Web Platform

Do Pahiye

Two-Wheeler Discovery & Purchase Platform · Outsourced

RoleUX Consultant — Outsourced
PlatformResponsive Web
IndustryAutomotive E-commerce
Project Type0 → 1 Product Design
Discovery & Research

The Problem

India’s two-wheeler buyers had no single trusted digital platform to discover, compare, finance, and book test rides for bikes and scooters. The process was fragmented across OEM websites, dealer calls, and offline showroom visits — with no transparency on pricing, availability, or booking status.

!No unified platform for discovering and comparing two-wheelers across brands and budgets
!Test ride booking required calling dealers — no online scheduling, tracking, or confirmation
!Price opacity — ex-showroom vs on-road pricing unclear to first-time buyers
!Location-based inventory and dealer availability not surfaced digitally
!Post-booking experience completely dark — no status tracking or communication loop

Objective

Design an end-to-end two-wheeler marketplace enabling buyers to discover bikes by brand, category, fuel type, and budget; compare detailed specifications; book and track test rides online; and complete purchases with EMI and financing options — all in one seamless, location-aware web experience.

Design Goals

✓Intuitive mega-menu navigation across 10+ brands and 40+ models
✓Location-based inventory and dealer discovery
✓Streamlined 3-step test ride booking with status tracking
✓Rich product detail pages with specs, gallery, EMI calculator
✓Post-booking transparency: confirmation, photos, feedback loop

What I Designed

Key Features

01
Homepage & Discovery Hub

Hero banner with CTA, category filter tabs (All, Petrol, Electric, CNG), and curated sections for offers, accessories, and riding gear — designed to serve both intent-driven and browse buyers.

02
Location-Based Inventory

City selector with 8 metro thumbnails and 10+ other city chips; auto-detects location via GPS. Surfaces relevant dealer stock and pricing specific to the user’s region.

03
Mega-Menu Navigation

3-level mega-menu: Brands → Models → Variants with inline product preview card (image, price, colours, key CTAs) — reducing clicks to discovery from 5+ to 2.

04
Product Listing Page

Left-rail filters (Brand, Category, Fuel Type, Budget, Mileage) with card grid — each card shows price, colour swatches, EMI hint, and Book/View Specs CTAs. Group-by-series layout for large catalogues.

05
Product Detail Page

Full-page PDP: price + EMI calculator, colour selector, Overview / Features / Specifications tabs, gallery with video, performance callouts, and "Add to Compare" — matching OEM-level product depth.

06
Test Ride Booking — 3 Steps

Step 1: select vehicle + variant. Step 2: upload driving licence & Aadhar, schedule date & time. Step 3: payment confirmation — with login gate for unauthenticated users.

07
Payment & Confirmation

Post-payment success screen: booking summary, email confirmation, and live Test Ride Status panel (Pending → Confirmed → Ready → Completed) replacing dealer phone calls entirely.

08
Test Ride Tracker

Timeline view showing payment, confirmation, test ride completion date/time, test ride photos, and a feedback section — closing the post-booking transparency gap.

09
Authentication Flow

Login gate with contextual prompt ("Please login to start booking Test Ride") and unified Sign in / Sign up CTA — reducing drop-off at the intent-to-book moment.

Simplified Discovery

The mega-menu with inline product preview reduced the average path from landing to product page from 5+ clicks to 2. Location-based filtering surfaced relevant dealer inventory instantly, removing the offline dealer inquiry step.

End-to-End Booking Transparency

The 3-step test ride wizard with document upload, scheduling, and payment — followed by a live status tracker — eliminated dealer phone calls as the primary communication channel and gave buyers full visibility from booking to ride completion.

Trust Through Detail

Rich PDPs matching OEM-level specification depth, EMI calculators, and test ride photo documentation built buyer confidence in a category where trust and tactile experience are the primary purchase barriers.

“Do Pahiye was about bringing the entire two-wheeler purchase journey online — from the first browse to the test ride photo — for a buyer who had never trusted a screen over a showroom before.”
